notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Tweaks to rooms!
Better bounce behavior when bumping into walls
Keyboard mappings should work for non-QWERTY layouts now (prompts may still appear showing QWERTY keys though) - Didn't realize this one until I switched to Colemak, sorry!
